title: automobile/owners
description: One row per person who has owned a vehicle. Registered keepers. A person may own several vehicles over time and a vehicle passes through several owners, so the many-to-many relationship between them lives in ownership_history.

full_name.description: Spanish name carrying both surnames, the father's then the mother's, as they appear on a vehicle registration document.

national_id.description: Spanish DNI, eight digits plus a check letter derived modulo 23. Structurally valid so it passes a real validator, and registered to nobody.

licence_number.description: Driving licence reference in an invented format that deliberately does not match the real Spanish DGT numbering scheme.

birth_date.description: Date of birth. Owners are between 18 and 88, since nobody younger can hold a licence.

city.description: Spanish city of residence, which determines where the vehicle is usually registered.

province.description: Province of residence, consistent with the postal code that follows.

postal_code.description: Spanish postal code whose leading pair is the province code, so address validation passes.

phone.description: Contact number in Spanish mobile format, which is what a dealer or workshop would hold on file.
